defective_pattern: Omitting <w:bidiVisual/> in table._tbl.tblPr when constructing OpenXML tables.
why_defective: Without bidiVisual, MS Word renders RTL tables with LTR column progression, destroying the logical structure of Persian tables.
observed_symptoms: Persian table columns appearing backwards (left-to-right progression)
corrective_remedy: Always inject <w:bidiVisual/> into table._tbl.tblPr via docx.oxml.OxmlElement for all Persian document tables.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Missing injection of bidiVisual in python-docx table generation scripts.
